aggregation: Median, minimum, and maximum of independent run-level values.
cpu_scope: Host frame wall time for the measured render loop. Process CPU time and total loop wall time are reported separately.

gpu_scope.excludes: Presentation and the separately measured upload scope.
gpu_scope.includes: Outer renderer main-pass scope; it may enclose effects and offscreen work.
gpu_scope.stage_totals: Main, upload, effects, and offscreen timings must not be summed.
gpu_scope.upload: Upload is a separate disjoint attribution scope, not a complete frame time.

memory_scope.readback_pool: Window-target readback-pool bytes captured before close; this is not general Goo or GPU residency.
memory_scope.resident_counters: Cache, image, and text values are Goo logical resident-byte counters; not driver heap usage.
memory_scope.vk_allocated: Goo-tracked Vulkan allocations across memory types; not a physical VRAM residency measurement.

percentile_note: CPU and GPU P50/P99 are computed inside each run from its measured frames. Across-run medians and ranges are not pooled-sample percentiles or new percentiles.
